class.name: TweensGdGroup
class.brief_description: A playback handle for several tweens running as one parallel step.
class.description: Created by [code]Tweens.play_all(target, definitions)[/code] or [method of]. Each member honors its own timing and a separately supplied playback policy. If one stops early or fails, the group cancels its siblings. Build sequences by awaiting [member end] before starting the next step. Controls use Godot's main thread. C# equivalent: [code]Group[/code]. [codeblock] var move := Tweens.position_2d(Vector2(400, 180), 0.6) var fade := Tweens.modulate_alpha(0.0, 0.6) await Tweens.play_all(sprite, [move, fade]).end [/codeblock]

method.name: of
method.description: Groups existing playback handles, including handles on different targets. Starts no new tweens. Requires a nonempty Array of handles; duplicate handles are included once. Invalid input returns a failed group. C# equivalent: [code]Group.Of(handles)[/code].

method.name: rejected
method.description: Creates an already-ended result with [code]Tweens.Reason.FAILED[/code] and [param message] in [member error].

method.name: resume
method.description: Clears every member's explicit pause. Scene and owner pause modes still apply.

method.name: wait
method.description: Waits for playback to end. [param cancellation] cancels this wait, leaving playback running. Await the returned value; cancellation returns [code]Tweens.Reason.WAIT_CANCELLED[/code]. Without a token this is equivalent to [member end].

members.member: Internal completion observer. Use the public group controls and completion members.
COMPLETED if every member completed; otherwise the first early stop reason. Returns -1 while running.

Shared completion. Await this value: it is a Signal while running and the integer completion reason after settlement, so late awaits are safe. Cancellation returns a reason; failure returns [code]Tweens.Reason.FAILED[/code] with [member error]. Independent playback created by callbacks or awaits starts on the next eligible update with no inherited time. Use [TweensGdChain] for linked timing.
All member failure messages joined by newlines, or an empty string. C# uses an Exception or AggregateException.
Individual member failure messages, in settlement order. Empty when no member failed.
True when at least one member is active and every active member is explicitly paused.
True after every member has settled; equivalent to [member is_terminal] for a group.
True after every member has settled.
The grouped handles, in first-occurrence order. Returned as an Array copy; editing it does not change membership.

signal.name: ended
signal.description: Emitted once after playback settles, with its completion reason. Prefer awaiting [member end], which also handles already-ended playback.
